articles.summary: Distinguish whether an anomaly behaves more like a portal, fold, echo, pocket, overlap, or damaged boundary and identify the safest next test. It does not close or control the phenomenon by itself.

articles.title: Boundary Sign
articles.summary: Recognize planar pressure in color, gravity, echo, temperature, mood, or impossible geometry. Reveals that a place is influenced by another plane or realm.

articles.title: Brace the Advance
articles.summary: Anchor spear and shield together against one dangerous approach, protecting your own line and giving a nearby ally a safer position to stand behind. It is strongest against a readable rush, charge, or narrow lane.

articles.title: Braced Approach
articles.summary: You plant the haft and point to make approach dangerous before the enemy reaches you. Denies a simple rush, doorway, bridge, or narrow path.

articles.title: Bracing Lever
articles.summary: You set the staff between bodies, feet, doors, or weapons to create leverage instead of just striking. Use this to trip, brace, block a rush, or keep danger at measured distance.

articles.title: Breach Hew
articles.summary: You carve a breach through a formation, door, barricade, or monster guard by striking the same structural weakness until it fails. Opens a path for allies through resistance.

articles.title: Break the Front
articles.summary: Commit mount, lance, and approach to one disciplined shock line that can displace a defender, break a light formation, or halt a charging creature when the lane is physically open. It cannot charge through impossible…

articles.title: Break the Weak Point
articles.summary: Spot the least stable person in an enemy group and pressure them through intimidation, isolation, contradiction, or visible consequence. Targets the least stable person in a group to damage morale or force an opening.

articles.title: Breakaway Step
articles.summary: You launch into a clean burst before hesitation or terrain slows you. Use this to beat a closing door, reach cover, or outrun a sudden threat for the first stretch.

articles.title: Breaker Tap
articles.summary: You use a Dueling-family weapon to attack posture, footing, grip, or rhythm rather than raw flesh. Use this to stagger, interrupt, weaken a guard, or create an opening for the next exchange.

articles.title: Breakpoint Charge
articles.summary: You drive through the weak point of a shield wall, monster charge, or rider's guard. Can knock a target from position if your approach line remains clear.

articles.title: Breakthrough Charge
articles.summary: You and your mount strike as one body, turning charge, wheel, bite, kick, or trample into a coordinated breakthrough. Can break an ordinary line or scatter lighter foes when mounted space exists.

articles.title: Breakthrough Shove
articles.summary: Drive through a weaker guard with raw force and commitment. Forces movement, stagger, or opened space on a successful physical contest.

articles.title: Breakwater Rhythm
articles.summary: You drive a small boat through chop, pursuit, debris, or arrows by choosing the safest strokes and angles. Can break contact or reach cover when water movement is the answer.

articles.title: Breath Behind the Door
articles.summary: You focus on tiny breathing, cloth, weight-shift, or contact sounds to judge whether someone is immediately beyond a thin barrier or hiding nearby.

articles.title: Breath Mantle
articles.summary: You surround yourself in a close draconic manifestation of your established Type and Nature, using scales, coating, breath-pressure, haze, heat, cold, density, fluidity, or another fitting expression to create temporary…

articles.title: Breath Pattern
articles.summary: Read the build of pressure, posture, a Type or Nature manifestation, or ancient magic before a draconic attack or rite releases. Creates a chance to dodge, brace, interrupt, or shield others without granting resistance…

articles.title: Breath Pocket
articles.summary: You hold a small pocket of clean, stable air around a face or enclosed space. Use it against smoke, brief submersion, choking dust, thin air, or poisonous atmosphere while concentration holds.

articles.title: Breathless Veil
articles.summary: Shape a dense moving veil of smoke, soot, or ash-laden haze that obscures sight and scent while keeping narrow paths comparatively clear for chosen nearby allies. Wind, open terrain, and overwhelming dispersal can tear…

articles.title: Brew Diagnosis
articles.summary: You distinguish several components and preparation stages in food, drink, medicine, or alchemical mixtures, helping identify what went wrong or what is missing.

articles.title: Bright Smile Feint
articles.summary: You soften a tense moment with charm, humor, or harmless confidence. Use this to lower suspicion, recover from a social mistake, or make someone hesitate before treating you as a threat.

articles.title: Broken Vow Brand
articles.summary: You expose a magically witnessed broken oath as a visible or spiritual mark on the violator for a limited time. It reveals breach but does not decide legal guilt beyond the oath terms.

articles.title: Broken-Ground Sprint
articles.summary: You turn obstacles, corners, crowds, and bad ground into part of your route rather than barriers. Can keep speed through terrain that would stop ordinary pursuit.

articles.title: Bulwark Line
articles.summary: Anchor nearby allies behind a disciplined guard so the group does not scatter under pressure. Strongly improves group defense against breakthrough, panic, and forced movement.

articles.title: Bureaucratic Overdrive
articles.summary: You make forms, schedules, permissions, records, and officials move faster than they want to. Use this to secure access, organize a response, bypass minor delays, or turn chaos into a functioning process.

articles.title: Buried Cause
articles.summary: You connect records and remembered events to expose a deeper cause behind a feud, collapse, migration, reform, or recurring crisis without treating coincidence as proof.

articles.title: Buried Pattern
articles.summary: You connect a current crisis to an older war, dynasty, migration, disaster, or institutional failure and identify the part of the precedent most likely to repeat. Use this to predict the next pressure point or uncover…

articles.title: Calm the Pack
articles.summary: Blend magical affinity with practiced handling to steady several frightened animals or one dangerous beast long enough for controlled movement or communication. It is influence and reassurance, not automatic domination.

articles.title: Calming Routine
articles.summary: You use familiar touch, voice, feed, reins, space, and repetition to bring a stressed trained animal back toward workable calm before it panics.

articles.title: Campaign Design
articles.summary: You plan a major campaign around logistics, terrain, politics, timing, morale, intelligence, and enemy options, exposing where victory actually depends on more than winning a battle.

articles.title: Campaign Parallel
articles.summary: You compare a current conflict, march, siege, or political crisis to a documented historical case and identify one meaningful similarity and one dangerous difference.

articles.title: Canon of Last Appeal
articles.summary: You reconcile contradictory scripture, temple law, ritual history, schism, and precedent until the highest defensible religious interpretation becomes clear. Use this to expose fabricated doctrine, resolve a major…

articles.title: Cataclysm Blow
articles.summary: Spend everything on one overwhelming act of force against a foe, gate, siege obstacle, or monstrous restraint. Can break what should not yield unless the target is protected by exceptional magic or scale.

articles.title: Catastrophe Recognition
articles.summary: You diagnose the full escalation chain of a major forbidden working—what is already active, what remains latent, what event would make it catastrophic, and which consequences are likely to continue even after…

articles.title: Catch the Stroke
articles.summary: You find the boat's rhythm quickly and keep oars from tangling under pressure. Prevents wasted motion and lets a small craft answer sudden danger.

articles.title: Catching Edge
articles.summary: You use a small blade as a control tool, catching cloth, belt, sheath, fingers, or weapon hand in one continuous motion. Lets one precise strike become a disarm, trip setup, or escape cut.

articles.title: Cathedral of Facets
articles.summary: You raise a large crystalline structure of lenses, barriers, anchors, and resonant surfaces across a scene. It can reshape sightlines, store force, and control movement, but brittle failure can be dramatic.

articles.title: Caustic Thread
articles.summary: You shape a controlled line, droplet, splash, or coating of acid. Use this to weaken a lock, etch a mark, damage armor seams, dissolve bindings, burn through webbing, scar a monster hide, or make a weapon briefly…

articles.title: Celestial Lance
articles.summary: You draw an immense line of star-bright force from a known celestial alignment into one focused target or path. The attack is narrow and legendary, but requires clear alignment, visibility, or a prepared celestial mark.

articles.title: Center of Attention
articles.summary: You seize the focus of a room through timing, voice, movement, or performance and hold it long enough to deliver one message, distraction, challenge, or rallying moment that would otherwise be lost in the noise.

articles.title: Centering Prayer
articles.summary: You use prayer, doctrine, ritual words, or personal conviction to center yourself when doubt and fear intrude. Use this to steady attention during a simple rite, moral test, or unsettling supernatural moment.

articles.title: Ceremonial Correction
articles.summary: Halt or redirect a formal procedure by identifying a flaw in wording, precedence, witness order, authority, seal use, or ritual sequence. Halts or redirects a formal procedure by exposing a flaw in sequence or authority.

articles.title: Ceremonial Memory
articles.summary: Recall who stood where, who spoke first, what was witnessed, and which courtesy was broken during a formal meeting, rite, or ceremony. Reconstructs a formal event from placement, sequence, witnesses, and broken courtesy.

articles.title: Chain Leap
articles.summary: You chain leaps across unstable terrain, rooftops, rigging, cliffs, or battlefield chaos without stopping. Bypasses ground hazards and pursuit for one major movement sequence.

articles.title: Chain Lightning
articles.summary: You release an arc that jumps between nearby targets or conductors in sequence. Use this to punish clustered enemies, overload metal equipment, disrupt spell focus, or make wet terrain dangerous.

articles.title: Chain of Office
articles.summary: You coordinate several offices or jurisdictions whose records, permissions, personnel, and schedules normally conflict. Use this to build a functioning chain of authority across a large response, expose the exact…

articles.title: Champion Intervention
articles.summary: You surge into danger on behalf of another, reinforcing movement, defense, and resolve for one protective action. It can intercept a threat or hold a failing position without guaranteeing the outcome.

articles.title: Champion Light
articles.summary: You call up a steady heroic radiance that strengthens resolve and pushes back fear, corruption, or despair. Use this to rally allies, steady civilians, resist dark pressure, expose cowardice, or make a protective stand…

articles.title: Change the Frame
articles.summary: Read what the listener emotionally values and restate the same issue in terms they can genuinely consider without pretending their interests disappeared. It opens a door to persuasion rather than compelling agreement.

articles.title: Channelled Strike
articles.summary: Carry controlled magical pressure through a weapon, gesture, or martial movement without losing form. Lets one attack carry a fitting magical rider when the character has a valid magical source.

articles.title: Charge Lane
articles.summary: You turn a charge into a command over the lane ahead, forcing enemies to scatter, brace, or be broken. Can open a path through ordinary infantry or light cavalry.

articles.title: Charge Stop
articles.summary: You set point, haft, and footing so a charging enemy meets their own momentum first. Can stop or punish a rush before it reaches you.

articles.title: Charged Sky
articles.summary: You sense and lightly influence nearby humidity, pressure, static charge, and storm potential. It can warn of worsening weather or encourage a small local weather sign.

articles.title: Chase Turn
articles.summary: You use speed, wheel angle, brake timing, and animal rhythm to shake pursuit or avoid collision. Can turn a vehicle chase without wrecking the vehicle.

articles.title: Choking Coil
articles.summary: You tighten smoke around one target or small cluster, stealing clear breath and vision while following their movement. Strong wind, sealed breathing, or escape from the cloud can break the pressure.

articles.title: Cipher Crib
articles.summary: You use a probable word, name, date, or repeated phrase to crack a simple substitution or reveal a useful portion of a larger code.

articles.title: Cipher Scratch
articles.summary: You test a message for patterns instead of reading it straight. Use this to recognize simple codes, repeated symbols, hidden initials, altered handwriting, or suspicious word choice.

articles.title: City Underbelly
articles.summary: You read the informal criminal economy of a city or district as a system of debts, territories, fences, enforcers, vice, protection, and information, revealing where real leverage probably sits.

articles.title: Claim Chain
articles.summary: Reconstruct the most relevant chain of descent, marriage, renunciation, adoption, or inheritance around a disputed claim and identify where its legal or historical support is weakest. It does not decide the court's…

articles.title: Claim of Rule
articles.summary: Frame a conflict as a question of legitimate rule, command, oath, or sovereignty rather than simple force. Frames a conflict as legitimacy, oath, or command rather than simple force.

articles.title: Clean Hands
articles.summary: Use preparation, sanitation, and careful touch to prevent a bad wound from becoming a lasting infection or complication. Reduces the risk of mundane medical fallout.

articles.title: Clean Line Copy
articles.summary: You copy marks, notes, seals, or damaged writing with careful clarity. Use this to preserve information, notice a written mistake, reproduce a simple document, or make readable notes under poor conditions.

articles.title: Clean Shot Line
articles.summary: You take a breath and find a clear line through motion, cover, or confusion. Use this with bows, crossbows, thrown weapons, or future ranged skills to make a precise shot under pressure.

articles.title: Cleansing Flame
articles.summary: You burn poison, corruption, disease-like magic, or hostile enchantment out of a willing target through controlled restorative fire. The cleansing can hurt and may not remove effects stronger than your mastery.

articles.title: Clear Hand
articles.summary: You place a clear mark, signature, label, or copied line that will survive handling and later scrutiny. Preserves meaning when haste, damage, or poor tools would normally ruin it.

articles.title: Clearwall Labyrinth
articles.summary: Raise and reshape nearby glass or glass-like magical material into several transparent barriers, angled screens, channels, or cutting partitions that redirect movement and sight. The structure remains brittle compared…

articles.title: Cleaving Line
articles.summary: Carry one committed greatblade path through a clustered melee or broad obstruction so the same motion can threaten more than one immediate target. It requires room and a physically plausible arc.

articles.title: Cleaving Step
articles.summary: Carry a heavy blade through one target and into the space beyond without losing balance. Lets one successful strike pressure a second nearby foe or obstacle.

articles.title: Cliffside Leverage
articles.summary: Fight, shove, grapple, or disengage on steep or narrow terrain without surrendering every advantage to poor footing. It lets you use anchors and body position intelligently, not ignore falls or gravity.

articles.title: Clinch Break
articles.summary: Turn a close grapple or body-to-body bind into a sudden reversal that creates space, changes who controls the hold, or puts an opponent off balance. It does not overpower a stronger foe automatically.

articles.title: Clinch Control
articles.summary: You turn a clinch, shove, knee, elbow, or body check into control of the opponent rather than simple damage. Use this to pin a limb, break footing, deny movement, or open a follow-up grapple while staying inside weapon…

articles.title: Clinch Draw
articles.summary: Bring a light blade into a grapple or crowded body-to-body exchange where longer weapons are awkward, turning close control into a chance to escape, threaten, or reverse position. It still depends on access to the…

articles.title: Close Clinch
articles.summary: Step inside reach and deny an enemy the clean space needed for a proper weapon swing. Forces the fight into grappling, elbows, knees, and body control.

articles.title: Close Fang
articles.summary: You slip into dangerous close range where short weapons become harder to avoid. Use this with daggers, knives, knuckles, claws, or compact weapons to strike inside an enemy's guard.

articles.title: Closed-Line Riposte
articles.summary: Catch a precise attack on the shield without giving away your blade line, then answer through the opening created by the block. The technique rewards timing and measure rather than making every defense a counterattack.

articles.title: Coalition Faultline
articles.summary: You identify the issue, person, resource, or historical grievance most likely to split a working alliance or bring hostile factions into temporary cooperation.

articles.title: Coin Weight Hunch
articles.summary: You notice value, fraud, poor quality, or desperation in the small details of weight, wear, and presentation. Use this when judging common goods, prices, coins, or obvious trade tricks.

articles.title: Cold Stare Beat
articles.summary: You let silence, posture, and controlled pressure do the threatening for you. Use this to make someone hesitate, back down, reveal fear, or reconsider provoking you.

articles.title: Collapse Chain
articles.summary: You link several existing weaknesses so failure in one can trigger the next across a structure, formation, or prepared magical system. The chain stops where no real weakness exists.

articles.title: Collapse-Split Rescue
articles.summary: You clear rubble, brace weak points, and open trapped spaces without making the collapse worse. Use this to rescue someone, open a blocked route, or move heavy debris under danger.

articles.title: Colossal Step
articles.summary: You drive Titan force through one stride, landing, shoulder, or charge, letting your movement shake footing and push through obstacles that ordinary mass could not.

articles.title: Comet Flick Barrage
articles.summary: You throw several small weapons, tools, or objects in a rapid pattern that forces reactions. Use this to distract, wound, disarm, interrupt casting, or pressure several close targets with thrown attacks.

articles.title: Comet Knife Constellation
articles.summary: You send thrown weapons, tools, or small objects through several angles at once, creating a constellation of pressure. Use this to interrupt multiple foes, strike around cover, disarm, distract, or punish clustered…

articles.title: Command Aura
articles.summary: You amplify recognized leadership across a scene so willing followers, retainers, troops, or officials can understand and coordinate around your orders through confusion and pressure.

articles.title: Command Ping
articles.summary: You deliver a short, sharp command that gives people something clear to do. Use this to coordinate guards, workers, allies, frightened civilians, or a small group under stress.

articles.title: Command Seal Order
articles.summary: Your command lands like a stamped order, cutting through hesitation and scattered attention. Use this to direct guards, allies, workers, soldiers, or civilians during danger or crisis.

articles.title: Command the Crisis
articles.summary: You coordinate several groups with different roles through delegated orders, fallback priorities, reporting lines, and timing during a large emergency. Use this to keep a complex response functioning when no single…

articles.title: Command the Room
articles.summary: Control the rhythm of a formal room through seating, address, silence, and public expectation. Temporarily makes the social scene follow your chosen terms unless higher authority breaks the frame.

articles.title: Commander's Shot
articles.summary: Choose a shot for its effect on the larger fight: a messenger, banner line, signal device, exposed officer, or critical piece of equipment. It creates battlefield leverage when the target is genuinely visible and…

articles.title: Commanding Presence
articles.summary: You let authority settle into voice, posture, gaze, and timing until people feel the weight of command. Use this to make a room listen, rally frightened allies, steady retainers, challenge disorder, or force hesitation.

articles.title: Committed Leap
articles.summary: You compress breath, legs, and timing into one committed leap. Clears a gap, hazard, low wall, or sudden obstacle without losing the next action.

articles.title: Compartmentalize the Story
articles.summary: Give different contacts carefully limited versions of sensitive information so later rumor paths can reveal where a leak likely occurred. It creates a diagnostic network at the cost of preparation and trust.

articles.title: Compass Sense
articles.summary: You feel local magnetic direction, large metal masses, and unusual field disturbances. It can guide navigation or reveal concealed metal without identifying every object.

articles.title: Compassionate Boundary
articles.summary: Remain compassionate while refusing demands that would endanger the vulnerable, violate care, or compromise duty. Maintains care while refusing unsafe or manipulative demands.

articles.title: Complex Illusion
articles.summary: You construct a detailed multi-sense illusion that can hold up to distant observation and brief interaction. Use this to disguise an area, create false movement, imitate a person, or cover an escape while the illusion…

articles.title: Composure Under Scrutiny
articles.summary: Remain controlled while accused, insulted, watched, baited, or socially tested, denying opponents an easy emotional opening. Prevents opponents from exploiting accusation, insult, or baiting.

articles.title: Conditional Binding
articles.summary: You enchant an object, threshold, or willing target with an effect that activates under one clearly stated condition. Ambiguous wording, contradictory triggers, or hostile wards can weaken the binding.

articles.title: Confession Pattern
articles.summary: Recognize when guilt, fear, coercion, rehearsed repentance, or hidden pressure sits beneath pious or apologetic language. Reveals guilt, coercion, or hidden pressure beneath apologetic or pious language.

articles.title: Conjured Implement
articles.summary: You manifest a simple temporary tool, container, rope, light frame, or other uncomplicated object from bound magical substance. It cannot imitate rare materials, relic functions, or complex machinery.

articles.title: Consecrated Stand
articles.summary: Turn a defended place, patient, ally, or threshold into a matter of sacred duty. Strengthens resistance against fear, corruption, and forced retreat while the stand continues.

articles.title: Constellation Brand
articles.summary: You mark a target, place, weapon, or oath under the pressure of a chosen constellation. Use this to guide an ally, reveal a hidden foe, bind a movement pattern, strengthen a night action, or make a scene follow a…

articles.title: Constellation Ward
articles.summary: You place several star-like anchors around a group or location and connect them into a protective geometry. The ward can cover many angles but weakens if anchors are broken.

articles.title: Containment Circle
articles.summary: Use chalk, metal, salt, words, geometry, or prepared anchors to limit a magical hazard. Contains or slows an unstable effect while the circle remains intact.

articles.title: Containment Vault
articles.summary: You build layered magical seals around a dangerous object, creature, spell core, or breach. The structure can hold several kinds of pressure at once but depends on stable anchors.

articles.title: Contamination Nose
articles.summary: You notice unusual chemical, spoiled, poisonous, diseased, smoky, or alchemical odors before obvious symptoms appear, giving warning rather than exact identification.

articles.title: Context Before Contact
articles.summary: Read placement, surrounding debris, construction, wear, and provenance to infer what a relic likely did before anyone touches or activates it. It can expose danger or purpose without making the object safe.

articles.title: Contingency Cache
articles.summary: Reveal a prepared hidden note, coin purse, alias, tool, minor contact, or fallback resource where prior preparation is plausible. Reveals a plausible prepared resource, alias, contact, note, tool, or fallback.

articles.title: Contract Net
articles.summary: Bind a complex bargain so that breaking it costs reputation, access, witnesses, or future profit. Makes betrayal materially and socially expensive.

articles.title: Contradiction Notice
articles.summary: Spot one detail in a statement, testimony, rumor, or retelling that does not fit the rest of the account. Reveals a useful social inconsistency rather than solving the whole mystery or physically examining a scene or…

articles.title: Control the Floor
articles.summary: Use formal procedure and social reading to make a courtly dispute address one specific claim, witness, contradiction, or question before the room can comfortably move on. It forces attention, not a favorable answer.

articles.title: Controlled Breach
articles.summary: Identify or create a breach that opens a useful route while minimizing the uncontrolled collapse that brute destruction would cause. It needs a real structural weakness, tools, force, or preparation appropriate to the…

articles.title: Controlled Contradiction
articles.summary: Deliberately concede or correct one small inconsistency in a false story so the larger deception appears more credible. It creates plausibility rather than immunity to evidence or perceptive questioning.

articles.title: Controlled Failure
articles.summary: Deliberately make one understood structural or mechanical element fail in the least destructive useful way, such as dropping a gate, jamming a device, or isolating a damaged section. It requires access and a real…

articles.title: Controlled Sedation
articles.summary: You use available medicine, positioning, restraint, and monitoring to reduce pain or agitation enough for treatment while avoiding unnecessary loss of consciousness.

articles.title: Convoy Command
articles.summary: You command convoy movement through ambush, weather, broken roads, or battlefield chaos. Keeps multiple vehicles together and functional under pressure.

articles.title: Cost of Violence
articles.summary: You turn silence, reputation, and precise consequence into a weapon before violence starts. Can force a hostile scene to pause while enemies reassess the cost.

articles.title: Costly Refusal
articles.summary: You identify what the other side concretely loses by rejecting the present deal and make that cost impossible to ignore. Use this to move a stubborn negotiation without inventing leverage you do not actually possess.

articles.title: Couch and Recover
articles.summary: You set the lance for a committed pass while planning the release and recovery, reducing the chance that impact tears the weapon or rider out of control.

articles.title: Count the Hidden Cost
articles.summary: Combine market judgement with negotiation to expose where quality, scarcity, risk, transport, prestige, or desperation is distorting the stated price. It gives you a grounded basis to challenge the terms.

articles.title: Counteragent
articles.summary: Identify and mix a practical counteragent to poison, rot, fumes, acid, or alchemical contamination. Reduces or delays a harmful substance when proper materials are available.

articles.title: Counterbind
articles.summary: You convert a blocked or missed close strike into a bind, throw, or joint control before the opponent resets. Lets a successful close defense become immediate positional control.

articles.title: Countercipher
articles.summary: You deliberately construct or modify a message so a known codebreaker is likely to reach the wrong but plausible interpretation unless they detect the trap.

articles.title: Counterflow
articles.summary: Use disciplined movement to turn an incoming spell, weapon pressure, or magical backlash away from your centerline. Reduces disruption and creates a brief counter-opening.

articles.title: Counterframe
articles.summary: Build a quick theoretical answer to a spell pattern as it forms. Improves one attempt to interrupt, redirect, or withstand a known magical effect.

articles.title: Counterfrequency
articles.summary: Identify and produce the opposing resonance to one sustained sound, vibration, sonic attack, unstable object, or resonance-based magical effect. Use this to cancel, weaken, expose, or destabilize it without…

articles.title: Countermelody
articles.summary: You identify how a melody, chant, or rhythm is structured well enough to join, answer, or deliberately disrupt it without needing prior rehearsal.

articles.title: Countertaste
articles.summary: You compare a suspicious sample against known flavor patterns to narrow an unknown toxin, medicine, reagent, or counterfeit mixture without claiming certainty beyond evidence.

articles.title: Courage Mantle
articles.summary: You wrap yourself or one ally in heroic resolve that steadies fear, pain, and hesitation. It supports action under pressure without removing judgment or making the target fearless.

articles.title: Court Reading
articles.summary: Read alliances, jealousy, hidden insult, fear, and shifting loyalty through seating, silence, gift choice, phrasing, and avoided eye contact. Reveals alliances, jealousy, insult, fear, and shifting loyalty in formal…

articles.title: Court of Attention
articles.summary: You shape an entire room's attention through poise, confidence, reputation, and romantic presence. Can create an exceptional social opening, but still cannot force attraction, love, loyalty, or consent.

articles.title: Courtly Mirror Step
articles.summary: You reflect the exact manners, rank signals, tone, and restraint expected in high society. Use this to pass as socially legitimate, avoid etiquette traps, calm offense, or stand your ground in a formal room.

articles.title: Courtwide Rumor Web
articles.summary: You seed, suppress, or redirect a story through several connected social networks while watching which intermediaries alter it. Use this to pressure a target, shield a secret, or provoke revealing reactions across a…

articles.title: Cover Slip
articles.summary: Use cover, timing, and distraction to leave a watched position before attention fully settles. Escapes casual observation or a loose search.

articles.title: Cover Thread
articles.summary: Thread a shot through partial cover, shifting bodies, or a narrow opening. Reduces the protection of ordinary cover on one careful attack.

articles.title: Crackfinder
articles.summary: You reveal the weakest existing fracture in a structure, object, ward, formation, or magical pattern. It identifies where failure is most likely without creating the weakness from nothing.

articles.title: Crescent Guard Break
articles.summary: You strike around or through an enemy's defense with a sweeping burst of force. Use this to break shields, punish braced opponents, crack armor posture, or open a guarded enemy for follow-up attacks.

articles.title: Crew Cadence
articles.summary: You coordinate a crew through rough water, collision risk, or boarding pressure with clear stroke calls. Keeps a vessel moving when panic or injury would normally ruin timing.

articles.title: Crew Loyalty Call
articles.summary: Summon practical help from sailors, workers, guards, fishers, pilots, laborers, or locals who trust the character's judgment. Summons practical help from trusted workers, sailors, guards, pilots, or locals.

articles.title: Crimson Thread
articles.summary: You establish a blood-resonant link to a wounded, consenting, or previously marked target. It can track direction, sense injury changes, or support later Blood Arcana while the connection remains valid.

articles.title: Crisis Anchor
articles.summary: Become the point around which allies understand the entire crisis. Makes a willing group act with exceptional unity until the scene changes or trust is broken.

articles.title: Crisis Concoction
articles.summary: Combine rare reagents, timing, heat, and risk into one extraordinary brew for a decisive problem. Creates a powerful temporary solution if ingredients and preparation make sense.

articles.title: Crisis Dispatch
articles.summary: You compress a complicated emergency into a concise written message that tells distant readers what happened, what is known, what is needed, and what must happen next.

articles.title: Crisis Mobilization
articles.summary: You make bureaucracy behave like machinery under your control. Use this to mobilize records, permissions, schedules, workers, officials, and resources quickly enough to change a crisis response.

articles.title: Crisis Surgery
articles.summary: Attempt dangerous treatment in bad conditions using pressure, binding, extraction, stitching, or improvised tools. Can solve an injury that ordinary first aid cannot.

articles.title: Crisisworks
articles.summary: You keep essential crafted gear and simple field constructions functional through extreme damage, weather, pressure, or shortage by repairing, lashing, reinforcing, or replacing what can actually be worked by hand. Use…

articles.title: Cross Reference
articles.summary: Compare maps, ledgers, chronicles, marginalia, and rumor until one fact confirms or challenges another. Turns scattered information into a reliable clue.

articles.title: Cross-Reference the Impossible
articles.summary: Connect several independently incomplete records into one actionable conclusion when no single source is sufficient. The conclusion remains bounded by the evidence and can still require field verification.

articles.title: Crossroad Ward
articles.summary: You protect a group at a major decision point by revealing the moment when a choice would close off a safe path. It warns and bends timing without deciding for the players.

articles.title: Crowd Blend
articles.summary: Use clothing, pace, body language, and local habits to disappear into a crowd or workplace. Escapes ordinary attention without needing darkness.

articles.title: Crowd Break
articles.summary: Move through a tight brawl by using bodies as cover, leverage, and obstacles. Lets you reposition through melee without being easily pinned by ordinary fighters.

articles.title: Crowd Scent Map
articles.summary: You distinguish several familiar scent signatures moving through the same busy area and reconstruct who passed where when enough trace remains.

articles.title: Crowd Transfer
articles.summary: You use crowd motion, clothing, props, and expectation to make an object appear where it should not be. Can move evidence, keys, notes, or small tools through a scene without a clean line of sight.

articles.title: Crowdheart
articles.summary: You read and shape the dominant emotional rhythm of a crowd, court, tavern, stage, or battlefield audience, steering attention toward courage, outrage, laughter, shame, or silence while individuals remain free to resist.

articles.title: Crushing Momentum
articles.summary: Turn a successful heavy blow, shove, or grapple into continued pressure before the opponent resets. Keeps a target off balance through the next exchange.

articles.title: Crystal Growth
